full.ask: Which seven elements does TalkBack focus on for each post in the Reader list, and what does it say for each one?
full.reason: Each Reader list item has seven focusable elements, so a TalkBack user can still reach every post but must swipe many more times to get through the list.

neither.ask: Which app version and Android device and version were you using, and what does TalkBack announce for each of the seven focusable elements in a post?
neither.reason: Each Reader list item has seven focusable elements, so a TalkBack user needs extra swipes (21 to move from post one to post four), but can still finish the task.

no_steps.ask: Which seven elements does TalkBack focus on in each Reader list item, and which of them would you expect to be combined or skipped?
no_steps.reason: Each Reader list item has seven focusable elements, so TalkBack users need about 21 extra swipes to reach the fourth post, which slows the task without blocking it; the report gives the app version, device, Android version, swipe steps, and a recording, so a developer can reproduce it.

no_version.ask: Which WordPress for Android app version and which Android version and device were you using when you tested this?
no_version.reason: Each Reader item has seven focusable elements, so a TalkBack user can still reach posts but needs many extra swipes (21 to move from the first post to the fourth), which slows the task without blocking it.
